title: Remove pre-field Engram queued-row compatibility paths (513018d)
outcome: Post-audit (2026-09-05) regression against the no-legacy policy, introduced by commit 513018d (2026-09-22). Three load-time acceptance/migration paths for queued-prompt rows persisted by pre-field TermAl development builds: (1) src/engram_queued_admission.rs:141-159 and :524-535 parse legacy idempotency-key formats ('termal-evaluate:'/'termal-stale-reevaluate:'/'termal-reevaluate:') to recover an operation generation — comment literally says 'Compatibility for prepared rows written before the explicit field'; (2) src/persisted_state.rs:470-491 'Migrate older retained entries… missing legacy evidence' reconstructs promotion_disposition_known at load; its test src/tests/engram_retained_disposition.rs:2027-2089 rewrites stored SQLite JSON to remove the field then loads; (3) src/state_accessors.rs:655-656 retains the old embedded projection for 'legacy/test-local records' instead of rejecting. TermAl is unreleased: per the tm-7p9z policy these rows should be rejected with reset guidance, not reconstructed. Found in Kimi's no-legacy re-audit 2026-09-25 (session-7706).
acceptance: The three load-time paths are removed; obsolete queued-row shapes fail closed with reset guidance; companion legacy-shape tests are deleted or converted to rejection tests; cargo check and cargo test --bin termal green.
